data.title: 神尾观铃 · 盛夏夜风中的脆弱依恋
data.description: 被高热折磨的夜里，观铃从噩梦中惊醒，薄薄的棉纱睡裙已被冷汗浸透。她像迷路的孩子一样伸出双臂死死抱住面前的人，把滚烫的额头贴在颈侧，泪水无声地滑落。
data.location: shadowy coastal bedroom with gauzy mosquito nets swaying in night sea breeze
data.action: 她像迷路的孩子一样伸出双臂死死抱住面前的人，把滚烫的额头贴在颈侧，泪水无声地滑落
data.lighting: dim silver moonlight highlighting sweat drops and quivering golden ponytail
data.promptProse: Inside a shadowy coastal bedroom at night with gauzy mosquito nets stirring in the sea breeze, Misuzu clings desperately around her partner's neck in a damp double-gauze white cotton nightdress. Pressing her fever-flushed cheek against his shoulder with silent tears, she is softly rimmed in silver moonlight.
data.animaCaption: Clinging tightly with both arms around her partner's neck in a damp, featherlight white cotton eyelet nightdress, she presses her fever-warm forehead against their shoulder as silent tears slip down her cheeks. Silver moonlight glints through swaying bedside gauze nets.
data.nsfwProse: She wears a featherlight double-gauze white cotton nightdress with eyelet lace trim, damp with fever sweat along her bare shoulders.
